comment: The maker's manual calls the left-hand output 'Inv Out: CV output for inverted version of the tone envelope'; DrumCore.cc:153 puts out the tone envelope itself, not inverted, and the panel prints ENV OUT. The manual also swaps FM ENV and TONE ENV: it calls FM Env the duration of the FM envelope and Tone Env 'the decay time for the FM portion of the drum', while DrumCore.cc:221-238 give FM ENV the modulation-depth envelope and TONE ENV the oscillator's own amplitude envelope.
